categories.name: Reserve Ecosystem
categories.content: Decentralized Token Folio (DTF) issued and created with the Reserve protocol's open-source contracts (developed by ABC Labs).

categories.name: Tokenized Assets
categories.content: Tokenized products refers to digital representation of assets on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Dinari Ecosystem
categories.content: The Dinari Ecosystem comprises tokens tokenized by Dinari.

categories.name: TokenSets Ecosystem
categories.content: Interconnected platforms and services built around TokenSets.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Real World Assets (RWA)
categories.content: Real World Assets (RWAs) refer to tangible or physical assets that have value in the real world. The tokenization of RWAs involves representing these assets digitally on a blockchain, allowing for fractional ownership, increased liquidity, and more efficient management and trading of these assets.

categories.name: AUD Stablecoin
categories.content: A AUD stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Australian Dollar (AUD).

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: Tokenized Stock
categories.content: Tokenized stock refers to digital representation of stock on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Crypto-Backed Tokens
categories.content: Crypto-backed tokens are digital assets backed or collateralized by other cryptocurrencies. Stablecoins are excluded from this category and are classified separately under the Crypto-Backed Stablecoin category.

categories.name: BackedFi xStocks Ecosystem
categories.content: xStocks refers to the tokenized stocks and ETFs issued by BackedFi.

categories.name: Cybersecurity
categories.content: Cybersecurity projects enhance measures through services like smart contract auditing, security analysis, and bug bounty programs.

categories.name: Bankr Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokens deployed through Bankr (https://bankr.bot/) via the Bankr Terminal, Bankr agent/API/CLI, or a @bankrbot social command.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Uniswap v4 Hooks
categories.content: Tokens of protocols whose core product is built on Uniswap v4 hooks. Hooks turn the AMM from fixed infrastructure into a programmable platform, enabling designs that were impossible in earlier versions: dynamic fees that widen during volatility, MEV-mitigation through batched uniform-clearing-price execution, rehypothecation of idle liquidity into lending markets, vault-managed concentrated liquidity issued as fungible ERC-6909 positions, limit orders implemented as single-tick positions, and lending markets that share collateral with swap liquidity. Projects in this category use hooks as the foundation of their product rather than merely trading on Uniswap.

categories.name: Liquid Staking Tokens
categories.content: Liquid staking token is a tokenized representation of staked tokens that can be traded or used in various DeFi applications.

categories.name: DeFi Index
categories.content: A DeFi index is an indicator that tracks the performance of a group of DeFi cryptocurrencies.

categories.name: Strategy Games
categories.content: Strategy game is a video game genre where players engage in planning, resource management, and decision-making to achieve specific objectives.

categories.name: Zora Creator
categories.content: Zora Creator Coins are profile-level tokens on the Zora platform, a blockchain-based social network focused on the creator economy. Each Zora account has its own unique Creator Coin, represented by the user's username as the ticker symbol (e.g., $username).
